title: AS2 compiler: String(x) should emit ActionToString (0x4B), not ActionCallFunction
description: In compiler.ts compileCallExpr(), String(x) falls through to ActionCallFunction. It should special-case to emit ActionToString (0x4B). Pattern: same as int(x) → 0x18 and Number(x) → 0x4A. Fix: in the special-case block for global function calls (where int/Number/eval/etc are handled), add: if callee is Identifier('String') with 1 arg, compile arg, emit byte 0x4B. Also add 'String' to the collectStrings exclusion list. Add a test in packages/core/src/as2/__tests__/.
